current.jp: かんじの 書き方を おしえてください
current.kana: かんじのかきかたをおしえてください

structure_explanation.en: The target pattern is 〜方（かた）, "the way/manner of doing". It is formed by taking the verb stem from the ます-form and adding 方: 書く (to write) → 書き + 方 = 書き方 (way of writing). かんじの 書き方 = "the way of writing (of) kanji", where の links the two nouns. を marks this way as the object, and おしえてください (おしえる in the て-form + ください) makes a polite request: "please teach me".
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O padrão-alvo é 〜方（かた）, "o modo/maneira de fazer". Ele se forma pegando a raiz do verbo na forma-ます e juntando 方: 書く (escrever) → 書き + 方 = 書き方 (modo de escrever). かんじの 書き方 = "o modo de escrever (de) kanji", onde の liga os dois substantivos. を marca esse modo como objeto, e おしえてください (おしえる na forma て + ください) faz um pedido educado: "ensine, por favor".

translation_literal.en: Please teach me how to write kanji.
translation_literal.pt-BR: O modo de escrever de kanji [objeto], ensine, por favor.

translation.en: Please teach me how to write kanji.
translation.pt-BR: Me ensina como escrever kanji, por favor.

note.en: 書く (to write) in the ます-stem 書き + 方 = derived noun "way of writing"
note.pt-BR: 書く (escrever) na raiz-ます 書き + 方 = substantivo derivado "modo de escrever"

note.en: おしえる in the て-form (おしえて), used for the request with ください
note.pt-BR: おしえる na forma て (おしえて), usada para o pedido com ください

note.en: ください, polite imperative of くださる, attached to the て-form
note.pt-BR: ください, imperativo educado de くださる, anexado à forma て

objections.objection: The patch rebuilt and renumbered this token array (dropped the two whitespace/記号 tokens, reindexed i to 0..8) but left two phantom leading tokens: tokens[0]=書き[かき] and tokens[1]=方[かた], which are a bare duplicate of tokens[4]=書き方[かきかた] and carry null gloss/role. After the fix the token surfaces still concatenate to 書き方かんじの書き方をおしえてください, which is NOT the jp (かんじの書き方をおしえてください), and the token readings concatenate to かきかたかんじのかきかたをおしえてください, which is NOT the fixed kana (かんじのかきかたをおしえてください). So the repaired kana/romaji and the token stream no longer describe the same sentence, and the learner-facing dissection opens with a phantom word before the sentence begins. The sibling whitespace fix in this same batch (sent:gen-eed85beda3d6) came out fully aligned, so this one is an incomplete application of the same repair.
objections.auditor_hint: Delete tokens[0] (書き/かき) and tokens[1] (方/かた) and renumber i to 0..6, giving かんじ / の / 書き方 / を / おしえ / て / ください, which reconstructs both jp and kana exactly.

current.jp: 仮に人口が１８００人とします
current.kana: かりにじんこうがせんはっぴゃくにんとします

structure_explanation.en: The core structure is 〜とする ('to suppose/assume that something is X'), here in the polite form とします. 仮に ('hypothetically, let's suppose') reinforces that this is a supposition. 人口が is the subject (the population); the particle と marks the content of the supposition (that it is 1,800 people), functioning as 'that it is/as being'. 人 is the counter for people attached to the number 1,800.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A estrutura central é 〜とする ('supor/considerar que algo é X'), aqui na forma polida とします. 仮に ('hipoteticamente, vamos supor') reforça que se trata de uma suposição. 人口が é o sujeito (a população); a partícula と marca o conteúdo da suposição (que são 1.800 pessoas), funcionando como 'que é/como sendo'. 人 é o contador de pessoas anexado ao número 1.800.

translation_literal.en: Hypothetically, as for the population, we take it as being 1,800 people.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Hipoteticamente, quanto à população, como sendo 1.800 pessoas, fazemos.

translation.pt-BR: Vamos supor que a população seja de 1.800 pessoas.

role.en: base of the adverb 仮に

gloss.en: to do; here 'to assume/suppose (that it is)'

note.en: stem し of する, within the expression 〜とする ('to suppose that')
note.pt-BR: radical し de する, dentro da expressão 〜とする ('supor que')

note.en: ます puts する in the polite form します
note.pt-BR: ます deixa する na forma polida します

objections.objection: Rule violation left in the after state: 人口が is が-marked (subject), yet lit_en says 'Hypothetically, as for the population, we take it as being 1,800 people.' and lit_pt says 'Hipoteticamente, quanto à população, como sendo 1.800 pessoas, fazemos.' The 'As for X / Quanto a X' device is reserved for the topic particle は, and this sentence contains no は — it teaches が as a topic marker. This is the identical defect class this same batch rates 'major' and fixes in sent:jec-0410 (私が), sent:gen-f96330fd98cc and sent:gen-fa65f170e98c (を). Pre-existing (not introduced by this patch) but it ships with it and is inconsistent with the batch's own standard.
objections.auditor_hint: en: 'Hypothetically, the population (が), we take it as being 1,800 people.' / pt-BR: 'Hipoteticamente, a população (が), como sendo 1.800 pessoas, fazemos.'

current.jp: 試験官がキョロキョロと周りを見た
current.kana: しけんかんがきょろきょろとまわりをみた

structure_explanation.en: The subject is 試験官が ('the proctor/test administrator'). キョロキョロ is a mimetic word (gitaigo) describing the act of looking restlessly from side to side; together with the particle と, it becomes an adverb that modifies the verb. The object is 周りを ('the surroundings, around'), and the main verb is 見た ('looked'), in the past.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O sujeito é 試験官が ('o fiscal/aplicador da prova'). キョロキョロ é uma palavra mimética (gitaigo) que descreve o ato de olhar inquietamente de um lado para o outro; junto da partícula と, vira um advérbio que modifica o verbo. O objeto é 周りを ('os arredores, ao redor'), e o verbo principal é 見た ('olhou'), no passado.

translation_literal.en: As for the inspector (が), restlessly/looking all around (キョロキョロと), the surroundings (を), he looked at.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto ao fiscal (が), de modo inquieto/olhando para todo lado (キョロキョロと), os arredores (を), olhou.

translation.pt-BR: O fiscal olhou em volta, de um lado para o outro.

gloss.en: looking around restlessly side to side (onomatopoeia)
gloss.pt-BR: olhando inquieto de um lado para o outro (onomatopeia)
arredores, o que está em volta

note.en: stem 見- of 見る, linked to the past auxiliary た
note.pt-BR: raiz 見- de 見る, ligada ao auxiliar de passado た

objections.objection: Incomplete category fix. Both explanations were changed from "onomatopoeia (giongo)" to "mimetic word (gitaigo)" / "palavra mimética (gitaigo)" precisely because キョロキョロ imitates no sound, but the token gloss still labels it "looking around restlessly side to side (onomatopoeia)" / "olhando inquieto de um lado para o outro (onomatopeia)". In en and pt-BR 'onomatopoeia/onomatopeia' implies sound imitation, so the record now teaches both the corrected and the rejected category for the same word. The token role field ("adverb (mimetic)" / "advérbio (mimético)") is already correct, which makes the gloss the lone holdout.
objections.auditor_hint: en: "looking around restlessly side to side (mimetic word, gitaigo)" / pt-BR: "olhando inquieto de um lado para o outro (palavra mimética, gitaigo)"

current.jp: 私が今こうして、二日分の日記を書く
current.kana: わたしがいまこうして、ふつかぶんのにっきをかく

structure_explanation.en: The subject 私 is marked by が, giving emphasis to 'I' as the one performing the action. The sequence こうして ('in this way, like this') comes from こう ('thus') + する in the -て form, and functions as 'doing it this way / it is in this manner that'. 二日分 means 'the portion/amount equivalent to two days', and の links it to 日記 ('diary'); を marks the object, closed by the verb 書く ('to write') in dictionary form.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O sujeito 私 é marcado por が, dando ênfase a 'eu' como quem realiza a ação. A sequência こうして ('desta forma, assim') vem de こう ('assim') + する na forma -て, e funciona como 'fazendo assim / é desse jeito que'. 二日分 significa 'a porção/quantidade equivalente a dois dias', e の liga isso a 日記 ('diário'); を marca o objeto, encerrado pelo verbo 書く ('escrever') na forma de dicionário.

translation_literal.en: As for me, now, doing it this way, I write the diary covering two days.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a mim, agora, fazendo desta forma, escrevo o diário referente a dois dias.

translation.pt-BR: Agora, é assim que eu escrevo o diário de dois dias de uma vez.

gloss.en: to do (here in こうして = 'doing it this way')
gloss.pt-BR: fazer (aqui em こうして = 'fazendo assim')

note.en: -て form of する (stem し- + て)
note.pt-BR: forma -て de する (raiz し- + て)

gloss.en: portion, amount equivalent to (二日分 = 'the equivalent of two days')
gloss.pt-BR: porção, parte equivalente a (二日分 = 'o equivalente a dois dias')

note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário (presente/futuro) de 書く

objections.objection: The sentence-level fix is right (二日分 = ふつかぶん, and kana/romaji now agree), but it was achieved by assigning 二 the reading ふつ. ふつ is not a reading of 二 in any dictionary - ふつか is an unanalyzable native reading of the whole 二日, and the split 二=ふつ + 日=か is a back-formation that exists only to make the token readings concatenate. The previous value ふた was contextually wrong but at least a real reading of 二 (ふたつ, ふたり), so a learner reading the token table now sees an invented reading. Fixing it properly means merging tokens 7 and 8 rather than re-splitting the kana.
objections.auditor_hint: Merge tokens[7] 二 and tokens[8] 日 into a single token 二日 with r = ふつか (leaving 分 = ぶん), instead of tokens[7].r = ふつ.

current.jp: 小説を書く方が得意だ
current.kana: しょうせつをかくほうがとくいだ

structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the pattern 〜方が得意だ ('to be better at / to have more facility with'). 小説を書く ('to write novels') is a clause that modifies 方 ('side, option'), forming 小説を書く方 ('the side of writing novels'). This group is marked by が and the predicate is 得意だ ('to be good/to have facility'). The focus is an implicit comparison of skill at the N4 level.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase usa o padrão 〜方が得意だ ('ser melhor em / ter mais facilidade com'). 小説を書く ('escrever romances') é uma oração que modifica 方 ('lado, opção'), formando 小説を書く方 ('o lado de escrever romances'). Esse grupo é marcado por が e o predicado é 得意だ ('ser bom/ter facilidade'). O foco aqui é uma comparação implícita de habilidade no nível N4.

translation_literal.en: As for this, the side (が) of writing novels (を) is the strong point.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a (isto), o lado (が) de escrever romances (を) é o forte.

role.en: verb of the clause modifying 方
role.pt-BR: verbo da oração que modifica 方

note.en: dictionary form of 書く, modifying the noun 方
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de 書く, modificando o substantivo 方

note.en: neutral/casual form of the copula だ

objections.objection: The particle-mapping fix is correct, but the rewritten literal mirror still opens with 'As for this,' / 'Quanto a (isto),'. 小説を書く方が得意だ contains no は at all, so the 'As for X / Quanto a X' device is applied to a topic that does not exist; worse, the implied topic of the sentence is the speaker (translation.pt-BR: 'Sou melhor em escrever romances'), so 'this / isto' also names the wrong referent. In the very field whose job is to mirror structure, and which this patch rewrote, it invents a topic marker and points it at the wrong constituent.
objections.auditor_hint: en: "The side (が) of writing novels (を) is the strong point." / pt-BR: "O lado (が) de escrever romances (を) é o forte."
